verdicts.reason: A is a clean left-to-right banner: the can sits on the left and the logo, headline, CTA and legal line form a readable text block on the right. Its flaws: the CTA is pushed right of the shared axis that the GLACIER logo and headline sit on. The decorative circles are squashed into ellipses and jammed against the right edge, and there is dead space below the can. B makes the headline far too large and breaks it with 'fizz' orphaned on its own line. Its legal text is shrunk to an illegible wrapped scrap beside the CTA, the logo and can are piled onto the teal circle in a cramped corner, and the CTA is jammed under the oversized headline.
